headline: A second way out for Upper Hammonds Plains? Survey closed, results due early 2027
dek: The city asked residents about new connector roads to Upper Tantallon to improve access and emergency evacuation.

facts.v: Results and recommendations to Regional Council, early 2027
Upper Hammonds Plains and Upper Tantallon

body: The municipality is studying one or more connector roads between Upper Hammonds Plains and Upper Tantallon. The goals are better access to the community and a way out in an emergency.

Residents gave feedback through an online survey that ran Oct. 5 to 23, and at two drop-in sessions: Oct. 7 at the Upper Hammonds Plains Community Centre and Oct. 15 at the Tantallon Public Library. The study looks at routing, connectivity, traffic flow and design, and at the policy changes needed before a road could be built.

The city says the work responds to ongoing conversations about community resilience and emergency preparedness. It is being coordinated with the Upper Hammonds Plains Community Action Planning process for this historic African Nova Scotian community.
means: The feedback window has closed. Staff will report to Regional Council when the study wraps up in early 2027.
To follow the related community planning work, see engagehalifax.ca/anscap/UHP.
